radiusSource: Radius 37.984 (34.334 to 42.272) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 26,425,684 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 5.381 (5.173 to 5.422) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5096 +/- 3.7 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6881624509796808576: teff_gspphot 5096.0806 K (16th-84th percentiles 5092.093-5099.551), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 6881624509796808576: teff_gspphot 5096.0806 K (16th-84th percentiles 5092.093-5099.551), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
